description: Bringing Wetlands to Market is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Waquoit Bay National Estuarine Research Reserve; National Estuarine Research Reserve System; Massachusetts Department of Conservation and Recreation. Coastal managers can use this spreadsheet file to estimate the potential carbon storage of a wetland region. Research indicates that coastal wetlands might capture and store carbon at rates three to five times greater than forests. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Flooding – General, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Water Quality. Assets: Natural Areas and Wildlife. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
